comparison.objective: Move hex nuts from a bin to a tray while recording their count on a mechanical tally counter.
comparison.physical_skill: Part transfer coordinated with counter reset and repeated key actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Counter first reaches 0000, final reading matches the released nuts resting in the tray, with no dropped nuts.
comparison.reason: Counting-state synchronization and repetitive pick-and-place do not exercise precision interface mating or rolling-element containment.
